title: Count Valid Word Occurrences
summary: Join the chunks without inserting separators. A hyphen belongs to a word only when its immediate neighbors in the joined text are lowercase letters. Words are maximal runs of lowercase letters and such joining hyphens; all other characters separate words. For each query, return its exact whole-word occurrence count, preserving query order.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 chunks and queries; each string length 1..100000; total chunk length and total query length each <=100000. Chunks use lowercase letters, spaces and hyphens. Queries use lowercase letters and hyphens, with no leading/trailing or consecutive hyphens.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
